summary: Bright Minds Biosciences Inc. filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing a Report of Voting Results under NI 51-102 for its annual general meeting held March 31, 2026. Holders of 7,877,637 common shares voted, representing 80.49% of outstanding shares. All six director nominees were elected, with Nils Bottler receiving the lowest support at 89.76% for and 10.24% withheld, and De Visser Gray LLP appointed auditor with 99.94% support. No transaction, strategic event, or special situation is disclosed; this is an ordinary meeting-results filing.
